column1: # Dòng log ĐÃ BIẾT trên Samhie, kèm lời giải thích cho S-bot (assistant-journal
# gắn vào dòng khớp). Model 9B gặp log lạ thì tự bịa nguyên nhân — ở đây chỉ
# ghi điều ĐÃ ĐO (docs/NOTES.md "Nhiễu khởi động"); chưa rõ thì nói chưa rõ.
# Cột cách nhau bằng TAB: tên tiến trình (regex, khớp cả tên), tin (regex,
# tìm trong tin), lời giải thích (tiếng Anh, model dịch theo người hỏi), và
# tuỳ chọn `early` = chỉ áp cho dòng in lúc khởi động sớm (initrd).

column3: A bug in the mainboard's BIOS (its ACPI tables); harmless, the system works normally. Only a BIOS update from the board maker could remove it.
Printed during early startup (the initrd), before the real system with all its groups and users is running; harmless.

column2: /(home|srv|root|mnt|opt) already exists and is not a directory
column3: Normal on Fedora Atomic: these folders are links into /var (/home -> /var/home); harmless.
Known Samhie issue: /etc/fstab has an entry for / but / is a read-only image (composefs), so remounting it fails. Harmless; the Samhie developers know about it.
Known Samhie issue, cause not checked yet. Samhie still starts and updates normally; the Samhie developers know about it.

The TPM refuses the disk PIN after too many wrong tries. It forgives wrong tries slowly while the computer stays on; restarting does not help. How long depends on the TPM chip and S-bot cannot read it, so give no number of hours or days: just say it takes hours. Until then the system asks for the long recovery password instead; data is safe.
The disk PIN was refused (wrong PIN, or the TPM is locked after earlier wrong tries); the system then asks for the long recovery password.

column2: Data recovery specialists reported serious problems|older WD SMR HDDs
column3: A general warning from smartd's drive list about this Western Digital model (SMR drives); not a sign that this drive is failing. `sudo smartctl -a` with the device from the line (e.g. /dev/sda) shows the drive's own health report.
